answer_1.quote: We introduce SITUATEDQA, a dataset comprised of questions from existing open-retrieval QA datasets that have been re-annotated for their contextdependence and answers across different situations (i.e., temporal or geographical contexts).

answer_4.quote: We approximate human performance on situated QA using 100 randomly sampled examples from each context type which are annotated by the authors of this paper.
answer_4.guideline: Discrepancies are often due to ambiguous questions or equivalent answer forms (e.g., July 5, 1945 vs. 5 July 1945, The Patriots vs. New England Patriots).
